summary: Falmouth, Cumberland County lookout built 1931, relocated to Opportunity Hill in 1942; a May 2026 trail report describes a fenced fire tower on the summit, so the gone status is disputed.

facts.status_note: The FFLA list marks it gone after a 1942 relocation; a May 2026 trail report describes a fenced fire tower on the summit and does not say which tower it is

access.note: Trail report says the tower is off limits behind a fence; the access road is not posted against hikers

visit.trail_note: Access road starts off Blackstrap Road and passes through a gate; the report calls the tower off limits

events.note: Lookout erected on Blackstrap Hill in Cumberland County, per the 1931 annual report

Relocated to Opportunity Hill; the sources read do not place Opportunity Hill
Registered September 15, 2008; nominated by Henry Isenberg
May 2026 trail report describes a fire tower on the summit behind a fence, with commercial communications equipment

corrections.why: FFLOS says the lookout was relocated in 1942, but a May 2026 trail report describes a fire tower on the summit. The report is unverified; a site check or photo is needed before the gone status stands.

notes_for_editor: No staffing source found: a Facebook post by the FFLA Maine chapter claims about ten years of staffing, but the page would not load, so it is not cited. Opportunity Hill is not placed in any source read; it may or may not be the Opportunity Farm site in New Gloucester, and no source links them. A Facebook group post mentions an 1853 observation tower on Blackstrap Hill; not used. The 47-ft towers mentioned in the 1931 report are not tied to Blackstrap in the sources.
